challenge.title: Different Missions.
challenge.description: Mission-driven organizations don't struggle with purpose — they struggle with the systems designed to carry it. As complexity grows, even the most aligned teams face structural gaps that undermine their impact.

items.description: Strong purpose and values exist, but the operational architecture to sustain them doesn't.

items.title: People Over Systems
items.description: Organizations depend on individual energy and heroic effort instead of structural coherence.

items.title: Execution Drift
items.description: Daily work gradually disconnects from strategic mission as complexity and team size grow.

items.title: Invisible Burnout
items.description: Fragmented decision-making, unclear ownership, and slow governance erode well-being silently.

challenge.closingEmphasis: It's building a system that can sustain it.
